description: Return the current WalletConnect session status: disconnected, connecting, or connected (with CAIP-10 address and chain id). Pass wait_ms (e.g. 50000) right after connect to long-poll: the call returns as soon as the wallet approves/rejects, or after wait_ms if still pending. No-op when not connecting.

wait_ms.description: Max ms to wait for a pending connect to settle before returning (long-poll; capped at 50000). Omit for an instant snapshot.

name: status
title: Connection status
